request: Implement src/transform_events.py run(payload). events use event_id, numeric updated_at and numeric source_priority. Keep the largest (updated_at,source_priority) per event_id, keep the first on an exact tie, and output selected full records in first-seen event_id order as {"events":records}. Preserve all public interfaces stated here. Python entrypoint is src.transform_events.run(payload). Inputs are JSON objects; return only plain JSON-compatible values (no Decimal objects, sets or tuples). Use only the standard library. Visible test tools check syntax only; functional verification is external.
title: Deduplicate event records deterministically
